versions.changelog:
Initial release of guaikei-video-copywriting-extractor:

- Converts video (Douyin, Xiaohongshu, local files) speech to clean, editable text using cloud-based large model transcription.
- Removes fillers, mistakes, and repetitions automatically; outputs ready-to-use copywriting.
- Supports custom prompts for tasks like summary, rewriting, golden quote extraction, shot breakdown, and translation.
- Simple command-line usage with support for both URLs and local files; easy prompt customization.
- Secure processing: only sends data to guaikei.com, immediately deletes files after processing, and requires an API token for use.
